subject: Close cadence reset: action register and risk lanes
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cobaltsystems.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@cobaltsystems.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close cadence reset: action register and risk lanes

Hi Sara & Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, your procurement timeline has slipped by two weeks from the original MAP and that pushes our cutover window into a holiday week. Before we lock any new dates I want to align on a pragmatic rebaseline that preserves the eval gating and avoids a risky all-or-nothing go-live.

Attached: updated MAP (MAP_Cobalt_v2.xlsx) with:
- A re-phased eval plan column with buffer lanes
- A light/medium/heavy risk lane tagging for each milestone
- Proposed canary cutover & fallback window (week-of Nov 22)

Ask: Could you review the attached and confirm by EOD Tue 10/5 which milestones you can compress versus which are fixed due to procurement/IT approvals? We'll hold a short alignment call Wed if needed.

If you prefer, we can also open a narrow rollback SLA for the canary so your Product team can validate with real traffic without full-cutover risk.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
[attachment: MAP_Cobalt_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cobaltsystems.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@cobaltsystems.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence reset: action register and risk lanes

Camila —

Thanks for the clean rebaseline. We reviewed the MAP and highlighted two procurement checkpoints that are fixed (security & budget approvals). Tom will own the IT change control but we can compress the integration testing window by 3 business days if we get the vendor attestation this week.

Action for Redwood: can you produce the targeted attestation language and a trimmed eval plan that focuses on the three anchor prompts we care about?

We prefer the Nov 22 canary as long as the rollback SLA is explicit.

—Sara
Sara Patel
Sr. PM, Integrations | Cobalt Systems
[sent from mobile]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cobaltsystems.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@cobaltsystems.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence reset: action register and risk lanes

Sara — great, thanks.

I'll attach a trimmed EvalPlan (EvalPlan-2027Q4.pdf) that calls out the three anchor prompts + acceptance thresholds (precision/recall style metrics and qualitative pass/fail checks). Karthik — could you review the attestation language below and confirm this is sufficient for Cobalt's procurement? If not, we can escalate to Laura for an exception letter.

Proposed attestation snippet: "Redwood Inference confirms that the deployed model variant will be run in deterministic mode for the canary traffic, data will not be retained beyond the validated eval window, and rollback to prior model variant will be possible within 30 minutes of detected regression."

I'll push both files to Drive and share the link by EOD.

Camila

Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence reset: action register and risk lanes

Thanks — reviewed the attestation snippet. A couple of notes from infra/runtime: 
- "Deterministic mode" needs to be clarified to the exact model config we will pin (e.g., gptx-7b-quantized v2 + no sampling). I'll add a short config appendix.
- Rollback SLA: 30 minutes is fine for the first canary if we pre-stage a rollback image in the same region; for full cutover we should make the SLA conditional on traffic volume.

I attached a short config appendix and a proposed simple monitoring checkpoint list (latency spike, token-entropy drift, failure rate) so Cobalt's SRE can tune alerts.

-Karthik
Lead Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Close cadence reset: action register and risk lanes

Camila / Karthik —

This looks good. Two procurement notes: (1) Security wants a short evidence packet demonstrating data retention rules for the eval window, (2) Our legal team needs the rollback SLA in the SOW appendix. If we can get those two items, procurement will approve on Oct 18 which keeps the Nov 22 canary feasible.

We'll mark the two procurement checkpoints as fixed in our side of the MAP.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, IT Integrations | Cobalt Systems

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cobaltsystems.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@cobaltsystems.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence reset: action register and risk lanes — escalation note

Laura — quick flag into your inbox. Cobalt has two fixed procurement checkpoints (security evidence packet and SOW rollback appendix) that are gating their approval on Oct 18. If we cannot deliver the evidence packet and SOW language by EOD Fri 10/15, the earliest viable canary slips to week-of Dec 6 due to holiday blackout windows at their side.

Request: Can we get 1) a short evidence packet enumerating data retention and access controls, and 2) a one-paragraph rollback SLA that legal can drop into the SOW? Karthik has proposed monitoring checkpoints and will prepare a runtime appendix; Grace can I ask you to pair with Karthik to produce the evidence packet?

I'll hold a 20-minute align on Wed 10/13 at 10am PT to triage any open items. If there are capacity constraints I may need to request an exec legal fast-track from you.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cobaltsystems.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close cadence reset: action register and risk lanes — evidence packet draft

Camila / team —

Attached is a first-pass evidence packet (Drive link) that covers: data retention policy for eval traffic, technical access controls, and an audit log export example. Karthik and I paired on the monitoring checklist.

Link: https://drive.company/shared/Map-Cobalt-Rev2

I also drafted a rollback SLA paragraph for legal to review: 

"Rollback SLA (canary): Redwood Inference will maintain a pre-staged rollback image in-region. In the event of a detected regression against agreed acceptance metrics, Redwood will initiate rollback within 30 minutes and complete traffic reversion within 90 minutes, subject to agreed operational working hours. For full cutover events, rollback timelines will be conditional on traffic volumes and change control approvals."

If legal needs stronger wording I can loop Laura for fast-track review.

Grace
Principal, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
[attachment: evidence_packet_v1.pdf]
